scenarios.name: pending
scenarios.description: an open checkpoint with no resolution blocks its dependent

scenarios.name: approved
scenarios.description: a complete checkpoint with a current resolution releases; evidence at the current values is clear (2a)

scenarios.name: approved-status-open
scenarios.description: a resolution alone does not approve: the checkpoint ticket must be complete

scenarios.name: stale-stored-digest
scenarios.description: the content changed while the stored digest did not: recomputation refuses the approval (2c for the dependent)

scenarios.name: resolution-generation-mismatch
scenarios.description: a resolution from an earlier generation does not approve

scenarios.name: acceptance-without-artifact
scenarios.description: an acceptance needs the reviewed artifact

scenarios.name: acceptance-with-artifact
scenarios.description: an acceptance with its artifact approves

scenarios.name: retired
scenarios.description: a retired checkpoint releases with its status open; completion after retirement is clear (2b)

scenarios.name: approved-evidence-on-retired
scenarios.description: evidence state approved against a retired checkpoint flags (2c)

scenarios.name: retired-evidence-on-approved
scenarios.description: evidence state retired against an approved checkpoint flags (2c)

scenarios.name: approved-generation-mismatch
scenarios.description: a reopen and reapproval with unchanged content moves the generation: old approved evidence flags (2c)

scenarios.name: legacy-approved
scenarios.description: legacy completion, no evidence, history only created and resolved, checkpoint approved: clear (3b)

scenarios.name: legacy-reopened
scenarios.description: legacy completion whose checkpoint was reopened and reapproved: flags (3a)

scenarios.name: legacy-retirement
scenarios.description: legacy completion, checkpoint retired: retirement is a release, clear (3b)

scenarios.name: legacy-pending
scenarios.description: legacy completion, checkpoint still pending: flags (3c)

scenarios.name: legacy-approved-side-conflict
scenarios.description: an approved-side conflict leaves the checkpoint pending: legacy dependents flag (3c)

scenarios.name: legacy-retired-side-conflict
scenarios.description: retirement adopted by a conflict: every event is release-preserving, clear (3b)

scenarios.name: retirement-adopted
scenarios.description: retire at 4, conflict to 5: evidence at 5 is clear (2b); evidence at 4, completed before the conflict, flags (2c)

scenarios.name: unknown-kind
scenarios.description: an unrecognized checkpoint blocks and never releases (1)

scenarios.name: null-checkpoint
scenarios.description: JSON null is present, not absent: unrecognized, blocks (1)

scenarios.name: soft-deleted-checkpoint
scenarios.description: a soft-deleted checkpoint never releases (1)

scenarios.name: missing-checkpoint
scenarios.description: evidence naming a checkpoint that no longer exists flags (1)

scenarios.name: malformed-evidence
scenarios.description: malformed evidence flags every checkpoint blocker (2c)

scenarios.name: open-dependent
scenarios.description: a dependent that is not complete is never reassessed

scenarios.name: ordinary-blocker
scenarios.description: a blocker without a checkpoint is not a checkpoint blocker

scenarios.name: resolution-revision-mismatch
scenarios.description: a resolution for another revision does not approve

scenarios.name: resolution-digest-mismatch
scenarios.description: a resolution for another digest does not approve

scenarios.name: counter-at-limit
scenarios.description: generation and revision at 9007199254740991 (MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) are valid

scenarios.name: generation-above-limit
scenarios.description: a generation above MAX_SAFE_INTEGER is unrecognized

scenarios.name: replacement-character
scenarios.description: U+FFFD in reviewed text is unrecognized in both languages (the app's decoder substitutes it for a lone surrogate)

scenarios.name: revision-above-limit
scenarios.description: a revision above MAX_SAFE_INTEGER is unrecognized
